name: Senator Brutus
notes: AC 15 (breastplate). Senator. Never present villain. Operates entirely through proxies.
gm_notes: Objective: destroy the spear before it destabilizes Rome -- he genuinely believes he is saving Rome. Goal: use the party as proxies without them knowing he directed them. Agenda: maintain deniability at every level. Secret: his illegitimate son is Lucius the Tribune, who is his field agent. Owes nothing -- Corvinus owes him. The arguments are good. The conclusion is wrong.
